description: Extension of OnboardingView adding a method to initiate a chat-based onboarding sequence when certain conditions are met.

classes.name: OnboardingView
classes.description: Assumed to be a SwiftUI or UIKit view managing onboarding process, extended here with chat initiation logic.

methods.name: maybeKickoffOnboardingChat
methods.description: Checks conditions and initiates a chat onboarding process by setting an initial message and sending it through the onboardingChatModel.
